answer_1.quote: We have conduct experiments on a variety of text generation tasks: machine translation, table-to-text, image captioning, commonsense generation, and keyword-to-dialogue generation.
answer_1.outputs: a numerical quality score together with a natural‑language diagnostic report (error locations, types, severity and explanation)

answer_2.quote: We assess the performance of INSTRUCTSCORE using Segment-level Kendall and Pearson correlations between human and metric output.

answer_3.quote: We leverage GPT-4's capabilities in information extraction, parsing, and semantic understanding ... to convert complex requirement queries into simple Yes/No questions.

answer_4.quote: We hired three human raters to annotate IN-STRUCTSCORE's diagnostic reports. Each rater will give a binary score for each field of error type, error location, major/minor label and explanation.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assess each field (error type, location, severity, explanation) with binary scores according to the M1‑M6 and G1‑G4 criteria.
